description: Explains what a Verilog module does, in plain English: its inputs and outputs, its behaviour and anything unusual. Suits learning digital logic or reading FPGA code someone else wrote. Returns the explanation as text; nothing is built or changed. Counts toward the daily design limit.

code.description: The Verilog source code, one or more modules (at most 20,000 characters).

name: explain_chip
title: Explain Verilog
